cues.en: Instructor: Now, I'm going to introduce you to another non-parametric version of the t-test, and that is called permutation testing.
cues.zh: 講師：現在介紹另一種無母數 t 檢定，稱為置換檢定。

cues.en: In fact, permutation testing is a general framework for doing many different kinds of non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 其實置換檢定是一個一般架構，能進行很多無母數統計。

cues.en: Not only the t-test, also correlations, for example.
cues.zh: 不只 t 檢定，例如也能用於相關。

cues.en: But in the context of this section, I'm just going to be focusing on permutation testing for the t-test.
cues.zh: 但本章只專注 t 檢定的置換檢定。

cues.en: The difference between parametric and permutation-based testing is really all about how the statistical significance of the t-value is evaluated.
cues.zh: 母數方法和置換方法的差別，主要在如何評估 t 值的統計顯著性。

cues.en: So what does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, normally with parametric statistics, whether it's a t-test or a correlation or an F value from ANOVA, a beta coefficient from a regression,
cues.zh: 一般母數統計，不管是 t 檢定、相關、ANOVA 的 F 值，或迴歸的 β 係數，

cues.en: the way that you determine statistical significance is by evaluating the position of your observed test-statistics.
cues.zh: 判斷顯著性的方式，都是評估觀察檢定統計量的位置。

cues.en: So your observed t-value relative to an analytic distribution of t-values that are expected based on the null hypothesis of no effect.
cues.zh: 也就是觀察的 t 值，相對於沒有真實效果的虛無假設下，預期 t 值解析分布的位置。

cues.en: Now, this analytic distribution of null hypothesis statistics, this is not something that you compute empirically by running a bunch of analysis
cues.zh: 這個虛無假設統計量的解析分布，不是實際執行一大堆

cues.en: where the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 虛無假設為真的分析，經驗計算出來。

cues.en: Instead, you just make some assumptions.
cues.zh: 而是做一些假設。

cues.en: You use a formula.
cues.zh: 使用公式。

cues.en: In practice, of course, you're using a MATLAB function or a Python function, and your computer is evaluating the formula.
cues.zh: 實務上用 MATLAB 或 Python 函式，由電腦計算公式。

cues.en: So you're not actually generating the null hypothesis distribution on your own, you are using a formula to derive it analytically.
cues.zh: 不是自己實際產生虛無假設分布，而是用公式解析推導。

cues.en: So that is the kind of standard parametric approach.
cues.zh: 這是標準母數方法。

cues.en: In contrast, what we do with permutation testing is say, well, I don't want to make any assumptions about where the null hypothesis distribution comes from
cues.zh: 相較之下，置換檢定會說，不想對虛無假設分布的來源，

cues.en: or what it looks like.
cues.zh: 或樣子做假設。

cues.en: I don't wanna make any assumptions about what shape it might have.
cues.zh: 不想假設形狀。

cues.en: Instead, I want to compute a null hypothesis distribution on my own based on the data that I actually have.
cues.zh: 想根據實際擁有的資料，自己計算虛無假設分布。

cues.en: And then we can interpret our observed statistic value, our observed t-test, relative to this empirical distribution.
cues.zh: 再相對這個經驗分布，解讀觀察統計值、觀察的 t 檢定。

cues.en: And this is really the primary difference between parametric statistics and permutation-based statistics.
cues.zh: 這正是參數式統計與以置換為基礎的統計，兩者最主要的差異。

cues.en: Okay, so how does this work?
cues.zh: 如何運作？

cues.en: How do we create this empirical null hypothesis distribution?
cues.zh: 怎麼建立經驗虛無假設分布？

cues.en: Well, so I'm gonna walk you through this using this example dataset.
cues.zh: 用這組範例資料逐步說明。

cues.en: So let's imagine these are our measured data.
cues.zh: 假設這是量測的資料。

cues.en: We measured seven data points and we have two conditions, so the blue condition and the orange condition.
cues.zh: 七個資料點，兩個條件，藍色與橘色。

cues.en: So this looks like a two samples independent t-test or unpaired t-test to me.
cues.zh: 看起來像兩獨立樣本、不成對 t 檢定。

cues.en: So of course, we compute the actual t-value, the observed t-value, as the average of these guys minus the average of these guys divided by some measure of pooled variance.
cues.zh: 計算實際觀察 t 值，就是這組平均減那組平均，再除以某種合併變異量值。

cues.en: And you know from the video on two samples t-tests that the way you compute the variance or the standard deviation and the denominator is, it depends on the characteristics
cues.zh: 從雙樣本影片知道，分母的變異數或標準差如何計算，取決於資料特徵

cues.en: of the data and so on.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: That doesn't matter for now.
cues.zh: 目前不重要。

cues.en: For now, what's important is that we have seven data points and two conditions, and I'm using it with, or I'm setting up this example with unbalanced conditions just to show you that
cues.zh: 重要的是七個資料點、兩個條件，刻意設定不平衡，讓你看到

cues.en: permutation testing doesn't require the two conditions to have the same number of data points.
cues.zh: 置換檢定不要求兩條件的資料點數相同。

cues.en: That said, in statistics, in science in general, it's good to try to match your sample sizes across different conditions.
cues.zh: 不過，一般統計、科學中，最好盡量讓各條件樣本數相同。

cues.en: It's not always strictly necessary, but it's generally a good idea.
cues.zh: 不一定嚴格必要，但通常是好主意。

cues.en: Anyway, that was just a bit of an aside.
cues.zh: 只是稍微岔題。

cues.en: Okay, so here's what we do.
cues.zh: 做法如下。

cues.en: We take all of our measured data and we strip them of their conditions.
cues.zh: 取出所有量測資料，移除條件歸屬。

cues.en: So we say there are no more conditions.
cues.zh: 不再有條件。

cues.en: We just put all of these data points together into one pooled condition, and then what we do is randomly reassign the conditions.
cues.zh: 把所有資料放進一個合併條件，再隨機重新指派條件。

cues.en: So we're randomly remapping these conditions, blue and orange, onto these particular data points.
cues.zh: 隨機將藍色、橘色條件，重新映射到這些資料點。

cues.en: So it might look something like this where we say, now one, four, five, and six are in the blue condition, and two, three, and seven are in the orange condition.
cues.zh: 例如現在 1、4、5、6 是藍色，2、3、7 是橘色。

cues.en: Now, notice, we haven't changed any of the data.
cues.zh: 注意，沒有改變任何資料。

cues.en: We're not changing the data.
cues.zh: 不改資料。

cues.en: We're not changing the data values, and we're also not changing the numbers of condition labels.
cues.zh: 不改數值，也不改條件標籤個數。

cues.en: So we have the same number of condition labels.
cues.zh: 條件標籤數相同。

cues.en: All we're doing is randomly changing the mapping between condition label and data value, so we're taking all the data that we have,
cues.zh: 只隨機改變標籤和數值的映射，使用原本所有資料，

cues.en: all the condition labels that we have, and just randomly swapping them with each other.
cues.zh: 和原本所有標籤，隨機交換歸屬。

cues.en: Okay, so that gives us a shuffled dataset.
cues.zh: 得到一組打亂的資料。

cues.en: And I'm gonna slide this over here to the left.
cues.zh: 把它移到左邊。

cues.en: So now, with our shuffled dataset, we compute a statistic value.
cues.zh: 對打亂資料計算統計值。

cues.en: So we compute a t-test.
cues.zh: 計算 t 檢定。

cues.en: So that gives us, well, however you compute the t-test.
cues.zh: 依照 t 檢定的計算方式。

cues.en: So it's the same as computing a regular t-statistic, although we don't have to worry about degrees of freedom and we don't have to worry about the null hypothesis
cues.zh: 和一般 t 統計量相同，但不用擔心自由度，也不必擔心假設 t 值如何分布所得到的

cues.en: distribution of t-test under the assumption of how t-values are distributed.
cues.zh: 虛無假設分布。

cues.en: So we just compute this empirical t-statistic based on these shuffled data.
cues.zh: 只是根據打亂資料計算經驗 t 統計量。

cues.en: Now, we would expect that this t-statistic is zero, right?
cues.zh: 預期 t 為 0，對吧？

cues.en: This should be zero.
cues.zh: 應該為 0。

cues.en: We are just randomly assigning the conditions.
cues.zh: 只是隨機指派條件。

cues.en: So the numerator should be the same thing minus the same thing.
cues.zh: 所以分子應該是同樣東西減同樣東西。

cues.en: And that should give us a t-statistic of zero.
cues.zh: 應該得到 t=0。

cues.en: Now, in reality, of course, it's not going to be exactly zero because we know that there is sampling variability.
cues.zh: 實際當然不會恰好 0，因為知道有抽樣變異。

cues.en: So it's gonna happen by chance that these three numbers might be a little bit larger than these four numbers average together.
cues.zh: 這三個數的平均，可能偶然比那四個大一點。

cues.en: So by chance, this is not going to be zero.
cues.zh: 所以不會恰好為 0。

cues.en: And so therefore, we don't trust one single shuffling of the data.
cues.zh: 因此不相信單次打亂。

cues.en: So we take this t-statistic, and then we plot that t-statistic here and we're gonna build up a distribution here.
cues.zh: 將 t 統計量畫在這裡，建立分布。

cues.en: So this was the first shuffling.
cues.zh: 這是第一次打亂。

cues.en: We go back and we shuffle the data again.
cues.zh: 回去再打亂。

cues.en: And again, we're not changing any of the data values.
cues.zh: 同樣不改任何數值。

cues.en: We're not changing the condition labels.
cues.zh: 不改條件標籤。

cues.en: All we're doing is randomly reassigning the condition labels that we already have to the data points that we already have.
cues.zh: 只隨機把原有標籤，重新指派給原有資料點。

cues.en: And we compute another t-statistic.
cues.zh: 再算一個 t。

cues.en: And I'm sure you see where this is going.
cues.zh: 相信你看得出方向。

cues.en: We end up with a distribution of t-statistics under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 最後得到虛無假設下的 t 統計量分布。

cues.en: And we know that this is the null hypothesis because we created it this way.
cues.zh: 知道這是虛無假設，因為就是這樣建立的。

cues.en: We randomly shuffled the labels.
cues.zh: 隨機打亂標籤。

cues.en: So that is our null hypothesis instantiation.
cues.zh: 這是虛無假設的具體實例。

cues.en: That's how we operationalize our null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 也是將虛無假設操作化的方式。

cues.en: So we get this distribution, and then we go back to the original data.
cues.zh: 取得分布，再回原始資料。

cues.en: So this is the data without any shuffling.
cues.zh: 沒有打亂的資料。

cues.en: And then we compute.
cues.zh: 計算。

cues.en: This would be the real test-statistic.
cues.zh: 這是真正檢定統計量。

cues.en: And then the question is, how does this real test-statistic, this t-value, relate to this empirical null hypothesis distribution?
cues.zh: 問題是，真正 t 值和經驗虛無假設分布有什麼關係？

cues.en: And if it's far away from this distribution, then we say that it's statistically significant.
cues.zh: 如果離分布很遠，就說統計顯著。

cues.en: We can say that it's unlikely to observe a test-statistic this large if the null hypothesis is true.
cues.zh: 虛無假設為真時，不太可能觀察到這麼大的統計量。

cues.en: Okay, so now, let me blow this thing up over here.
cues.zh: 把這部分放大。

cues.en: And now, I'm going to show you two different ways to compute a p-value with permutation testing.
cues.zh: 示範兩種由置換檢定計算 P 值的方式。

cues.en: So the first way is called the Z-value approach.
cues.zh: 第一種叫 Z 值方法。

cues.en: So we compute this Z-statistic, the Z-score, and that is our observed value minus the mean, so the expectation value
cues.zh: 計算 Z 統計量、Z 分數：觀察值減去平均值，也就是

cues.en: of the empirical null hypothesis distribution, which here, we evaluate as the mean.
cues.zh: 經驗虛無假設分布的期望值，這裡用平均值評估。

cues.en: So the average of all of these null hypothesis t-values divided by the standard deviation of this null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 所有虛無假設 t 值的平均，再以該分布標準差作為分母。

cues.en: So you can see why this is a Z-value.
cues.zh: 所以看得出為什麼是 Z。

cues.en: It is an observed data point minus the mean divided by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 觀察資料點減平均，再除以標準差。

cues.en: But it's also important to realize that this observed value is actually not part of this distribution.
cues.zh: 但要知道，觀察值其實不屬於這個分布。

cues.en: So this is an example of where you have to know the formula for the Z-statistic because you cannot just use the MATLAB function Z-score or the Python function Z-score to compute this
cues.zh: 這就是必須知道 Z 公式的例子，不能直接用 MATLAB 或 Python 的 zscore 函式，

cues.en: because this is not contained inside this distribution.
cues.zh: 因為這個值不在分布裡。

cues.en: Okay, so here, you get a Z-value.
cues.zh: 得到 Z。

cues.en: And with this Z-value, you can look this up on a normal distribution, a probability distribution for the normal function, and then convert that into a p-value.
cues.zh: 用常態分布、常態函數的機率分布查詢，轉成 P 值。

cues.en: So this method is appropriate for approximately Gaussian null hypothesis distributions.
cues.zh: 適用於大致高斯的虛無假設分布。

cues.en: So if the null hypothesis, the empirical null hypothesis distribution looks more or less like a Gaussian, then this is an appropriate measure.
cues.zh: 如果經驗分布大致像高斯，這就是合適量值。

cues.en: And we need this assumption here because we need the mean and the standard deviation to be valid and useful descriptors of this distribution.
cues.zh: 需要這個假設，因為平均值和標準差必須能有效、有用地描述分布。

cues.en: And that is only the case when the distribution is more or less normal.
cues.zh: 只有大致常態時才如此。

cues.en: So that brings us to the second method of computing the p-value, which is generally appropriate.
cues.zh: 接著第二種，一般都適用的 P 值計算。

cues.en: It doesn't actually matter what the shape of this distribution is.
cues.zh: 不在意分布形狀。

cues.en: And here, to compute this p-value based on counts, that's what this c is for, so probability based on counts, what you do is you sum up all
cues.zh: 根據計數計算 P 值，c 就代表 counts。加總所有

cues.en: of the null hypothesis values that are greater than the observed test statistic.
cues.zh: 大於觀察統計量的虛無假設值之個數。

cues.en: So essentially, we have our observed statistic here, and we wanna know how many times did our null hypothesis test produce a t-test
cues.zh: 有觀察統計量，想知道虛無假設檢定有幾次得到

cues.en: that was larger than the observed value.
cues.zh: 更大的 t。

cues.en: So maybe that's like 10 over here.
cues.zh: 例如這裡有 10 次。

cues.en: And then we divide that by the total number of null hypothesis tests that we ran.
cues.zh: 除以執行的虛無假設檢定總數。

cues.en: So maybe we did 1,000 permutations.
cues.zh: 例如做 1000 次置換。

cues.en: So if we have 10 values that were larger than our observed statistic out of a 1,000, that corresponds to a p-value of 10 divided by a 1,000,
cues.zh: 1000 次中，有 10 個值大於觀察值，P 就是 10/1000，

cues.en: which is one divided by a 100, which is 0.01.
So then we would get a p-value of 0.01.
And here, I say, be careful of which tail because you have to know whether your test-statistic is going to be to the right or to the left.
cues.zh: 這裡提醒，小心是哪一尾，要知道統計量位於右側還是左側。

cues.en: If the test-statistic were all the way down here, it could be a highly significant effect, but then we might find that 99.9%
cues.zh: 若在很左邊，效果可能高度顯著，但會發現 99.9%

cues.en: of the null hypothesis values were actually larger than our observe value all the way over here.
cues.zh: 的虛無假設值，其實大於那個觀察值。

cues.en: So you just have to be mindful of which tail you're doing to run this counts test.
cues.zh: 因此做計數檢驗，必須留意尾部。

cues.en: All right, so in this video, you learned a lot of things.
cues.zh: 這部影片學了很多。

cues.en: You learned about the key difference between parametric and permutation-based statistics.
cues.zh: 學到母數和置換統計的關鍵差異。

cues.en: And I discussed in this video just with regards to t-test, but the same principle holds for other kinds of statistics as well.
cues.zh: 這裡只談 t 檢定，但相同原理也適用其他統計。

cues.en: And then I gave you a detailed rundown of how permutation testing works for t-test, and I gave you two methods to compute a p-value
cues.zh: 再詳細說明 t 檢定的置換方法，以及兩種

cues.en: from a permutation testing framework for the t-test.
cues.zh: 從置換架構計算 P 值的方法。
